servers.purpose: Local Drupal source-code and sync-configuration inspection.

tools.name: list_custom_modules
tools.description: List installed custom modules and their paths by scanning the directory structure.

tools.name: find_hook_implementations
tools.description: Locate where a specific Drupal hook is implemented across all custom/contrib modules.

tools.name: find_service_definitions
tools.description: Map service IDs and PHP classes defined in *.services.yml files.

tools.name: find_event_subscribers
tools.description: Identify Symfony event subscribers configured in service files or classes.

tools.name: find_plugin_classes
tools.description: Search for classes annotated or registered as plugins of a specific type.

tools.name: find_form_classes
tools.description: Map form class names to their PHP file paths.

tools.name: find_controller_handlers
tools.description: Map route definitions inside *.routing.yml files to their controller classes and methods.

tools.name: find_preprocess_functions
tools.description: Identify theme preprocess functions in .theme and .module files.

tools.name: find_drush_commands
tools.description: Scan codebase for classes defining custom Drush commands.

tools.name: trace_runtime_to_code
tools.description: Unified entry point to resolve a runtime symbol back to its static file location.

tools.name: summarize_code_inventory
tools.description: Generates a narrative overview summarizing custom modules, total routes, and services discovered.

tools.name: read_sync_config
tools.description: Reads config/sync/*.yml files statically from disk. Represents the target state in Git vs the active DB state.

servers.purpose: Active and synchronized Drupal configuration and state inspection.
servers.data_sensitivity: sensitive: live Drupal configuration and state

tools.name: inspect_config_object
tools.description: Read a specific configuration object from active storage, sync directory, or both.

tools.name: trace_config_dependencies
tools.description: Trace dependencies (what it requires) and dependents (what requires it) for a configuration object.

tools.name: find_config_owner
tools.description: Identify which module or theme provides the default/installation configuration file for a given config object.

tools.name: analyze_config_impact
tools.description: Analyze deployment risks, affected domains, and dependents for a configuration object before importing changes.

tools.name: inspect_config_split_state
tools.description: List config splits (config_split entities) with their status (active/inactive) and split configuration files.

tools.name: inspect_recipe_state
tools.description: Check status, managed configurations, and drift state of applied Drupal Recipes.

tools.name: summarize_deployment_risk
tools.description: Generate a risk report of unexported configuration changes (drifts) and active splits before deployment.

tools.name: debug_state_system
tools.description: Read key-value data from the Drupal State system for specific allowed keys or profiles. Mirrored for availability in config context; canonical SQL impl lives in drupal-db-ops.

tools.name: diff_active_vs_sync
tools.description: Compare active configuration in the database with the configuration file in sync directory.

tools.name: detect_config_drift
tools.description: Scan and list all configuration objects whose active database state differs from the sync directory files.

servers.purpose: Drupal content model, fields, bundles, workflows, and permissions inspection.
servers.data_sensitivity: sensitive: live Drupal metadata and permissions

tools.name: inspect_content_types
tools.description: List node bundles (content types) with label, revision support, and workflow assignment.

tools.name: inspect_media_types
tools.description: List media bundles with source plugin ID and translation status.

tools.name: inspect_taxonomy_models
tools.description: List taxonomy vocabularies with IDs and labels.

tools.name: inspect_field_usage
tools.description: List fields on an entity type. Without bundle returns the field map across all bundles; with bundle returns fields for that bundle only.

tools.name: inspect_reference_graph
tools.description: List entity_reference, entity_reference_revisions, image, and file fields showing source bundle → target entity type and allowed target bundles.

tools.name: summarize_editorial_model
tools.description: Compact overview of an entity type: bundle count, top reference edges, and moderation state. Use before deeper inspection tools.

tools.name: inspect_display_modes
tools.description: List available view modes and form modes for an entity type and bundle.

tools.name: inspect_revisioning
tools.description: Return whether an entity type is revisionable and has a revision UI handler.

tools.name: inspect_translation
tools.description: Return whether content_translation is enabled for an entity type and bundle.

tools.name: inspect_moderation
tools.description: Return the content_moderation workflow assigned to a bundle and its available states.

tools.name: inspect_entity_types
tools.description: List all registered entity types with ID, label, provider module, and storage class. Use to discover valid entity_type_id values.

tools.name: inspect_bundles
tools.description: List bundles for an entity type. Call before inspect_fields to discover valid bundle names.

tools.name: inspect_fields
tools.description: List fields (name, type, label, required, translatable) for an entity type. Omit bundle to get base fields only.

tools.name: inspect_menus
tools.description: List all registered menus with ID and label.

tools.name: inspect_vocabularies
tools.description: List taxonomy vocabularies with vid and name.

tools.name: inspect_permissions
tools.description: List all user permissions with key, human label, and provider module. Supports query filter.

servers.purpose: Drupal runtime health, logs, queues, and registry diagnostics.
servers.data_sensitivity: high: live operational data and log samples

tools.name: debug_watchdog
tools.description: Query Drupal watchdog (dblog) entries by severity, type, message text, time range, request ID, or user. Use to trace specific errors or audit recent activity.

tools.name: debug_queue_state
tools.description: Inspect Drupal queue backends: item counts, age, and claimed-item counts. Use to detect backlogs or stuck workers.

tools.name: debug_cron_state
tools.description: Return cron last-run time, staleness status, and lock state. Use when cron-dependent features (mail, indexing, purge) appear delayed.

tools.name: debug_cache_state
tools.description: Inspect Drupal cache bins: existence, entry counts, and stale-entry ratios. Use to diagnose stale-content or cache-backend misconfiguration.

tools.name: debug_update_state
tools.description: Detect pending schema and entity-definition updates. Use pre- or post-deployment to confirm whether drush updb is needed.

tools.name: debug_environment_summary
tools.description: Return Drupal version, maintenance mode, PHP version, and DB driver. Use for quick site-environment orientation at the start of a session.

tools.name: debug_state_system
tools.description: Read raw Drupal state store values by exact key, prefix, or preset profile. Use to inspect runtime flags such as maintenance mode, cron timestamps, or install state.

tools.name: debug_runtime_health
tools.description: Aggregate health check across cron, pending updates, and maintenance mode. Returns OK or WARNING with alert list. Use as first-call triage when site state is unknown.

tools.name: debug_failed_operations
tools.description: Cross-domain failure scan: watchdog errors, stale queues, pending updates, cron staleness. Use for post-deployment triage or incident investigation.

tools.name: inspect_modules
tools.description: List enabled Drupal modules with machine name, human name, and version. Use to confirm what is installed or resolve a module's machine name.

tools.name: inspect_services
tools.description: List Drupal service container entries with IDs and class names. Use to find a service ID for injection or verify a service is registered.

tools.name: inspect_plugins
tools.description: List Drupal plugin instances by type (block, filter, condition, queue worker). Use to discover plugin IDs available for configuration or custom code.

tools.name: inspect_routes
tools.description: List or look up Drupal routes by name or path. Use to find a route name for access control, or to identify the controller behind a URL.

tools.name: search_runtime_objects
tools.description: Cross-search entity types, modules, and routes by keyword. Use when unsure which registry an object belongs to.

servers.purpose: Drupal themes, templates, render arrays, and attachments inspection.
servers.data_sensitivity: sensitive: live render and content data

tools.name: inspect_theme_state
tools.description: Returns active theme name, admin theme, base-theme inheritance chain, path, and defined regions.

tools.name: inspect_template_suggestions
tools.description: Lists template filename candidates for a theme hook, highest-specificity last. Use to find the correct filename for a theme override.

tools.name: trace_template_resolution
tools.description: Resolves a theme hook to its active template: filename, filesystem path, hook type, and associated preprocess functions.

tools.name: find_preprocess_chain
tools.description: Returns ordered preprocess function list for a theme hook. Use to audit what runs before a template renders.

tools.name: inspect_render_array
tools.description: Builds and returns the render array structure for a node or block, truncated at max_depth. #cache and #attached keys are stripped.

tools.name: inspect_library_attachments
tools.description: Returns `#attached` library list and drupalSettings keys from the render array of a node or block.

tools.name: inspect_blocks_and_regions
tools.description: Lists blocks placed in the active theme with region, plugin ID, weight, and status. Filter by region machine name to narrow results.

tools.name: inspect_sdc_components
tools.description: Lists all registered SDC definitions, or returns full definition for one component. Requires SDC module enabled.

tools.name: summarize_render_path
tools.description: Single-call render path summary for a node or block: theme hook, resolved template, preprocess function count, and attached libraries.

tools.name: inspect_themes
tools.description: Lists installed themes with machine name, label, default/admin flags, and enabled status.

servers.purpose: Direct SQL diagnostics and configuration drift inspection.
servers.data_sensitivity: critical: database access and settings.php credentials

tools.name: debug_watchdog
tools.description: Query Drupal watchdog logs via SQL. No Drupal container required.

tools.name: debug_queue_state
tools.description: Inspect Drupal queue sizes and items via SQL. No Drupal container required.

tools.name: debug_cron_state
tools.description: Read Drupal cron execution timestamps and lock status via SQL. No Drupal container required.

tools.name: debug_cache_state
tools.description: List cache tables, entry counts, and stale items via SQL. No Drupal container required.

tools.name: debug_update_state
tools.description: Query active module schema versions and scan filesystem for pending database updates. No Drupal container required.

tools.name: debug_environment_summary
tools.description: Get Drupal version, maintenance mode status, and database details via SQL. No Drupal container required.

tools.name: debug_state_system
tools.description: Read Drupal State system variables from key_value table. Mirrored for availability in drupal-db-ops; canonical SQL implementation. No Drupal container required.

tools.name: debug_runtime_health
tools.description: Analyze health status (maintenance mode, cron, db) using SQL data. No Drupal container required.

tools.name: debug_failed_operations
tools.description: Scan database (watchdog, queue, updates) for system failures. No Drupal container required.

tools.name: inspect_config_object
tools.description: Retrieve Drupal active config from DB or sync directory files. No Drupal container required.

tools.name: diff_active_vs_sync
tools.description: Diff active DB config against sync directory files. No Drupal container required.

tools.name: detect_config_drift
tools.description: Compare active database config table against sync directory files to find drift. No Drupal container required.

tools.name: analyze_config_impact
tools.description: Evaluate deployment risk and impact of config changes via SQL diff. No Drupal container required.

tools.name: summarize_deployment_risk
tools.description: Summarize overall risk based on configuration drift. No Drupal container required.
